name: West Ukrainian People's Republic
alt: Western Oblast of the Ukrainian People's Republic

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria
predecessors.text: Eastern Galicia: the republic 'controlled most of Eastern Galicia from November 1918 to July 1919'

predecessors.name: Austria-Hungary
predecessors.text: the eastern lands of the monarchy; the republic also claimed northern Bukovina and Carpathian Ruthenia but held neither

successors.name: Ukrainian People's Republic
successors.text: the republic, which 'became the Western Oblast of the UPR' with the Unification Act of 22 January 1919; Lviv had been Polish since 21 November 1918

ledger.x: 1 November 1918: the West Ukrainian People's Republic is proclaimed at Lviv.
1 November 1918: the Polish-Ukrainian War breaks out in Lviv.
21 November 1918: Lviv falls to the Poles.
21 November 1918: the government leaves Lviv for Ternopil, the capital 'until late December 1918' on the WUPR page.
Late December 1918: the capital moves from Ternopil to Stanyslaviv (Ivano-Frankivsk), the capital 'until 26 May 1919'.
22 January 1919: this record closes with the state, not with the war.
22 January 1919: the West Ukrainian People's Republic ends as a separate state.

wars.name: Polish-Ukrainian War
wars.outcome: Fighting began in Lviv on 1 November 1918; the Poles took Lviv on 21 November, the Ukrainians reached Przemysl's outer defences on 9 December and were forced back by 17 December, advanced 120 km along the Dniester by 27 June 1919 (the Chortkiv offensive) and…

certainty.note: A war front that moved from week to week; no treaty line.
